entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: Human wizard, pilot and former planeswalker from Shenmeng; hydromancer searching for her mentor.

entities.name: Li Shan
entities.description: Wanderer who raised Yanling and vanished after collapsing.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: Planeswalker who teamed up with Yanling.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Bolas used to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: Lure that drew Yanling and Yanggu to Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Recommended the planeswalkers split into teams.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who volunteered to protect civilians.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Planeswalker who volunteered to protect civilians.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event in which Yanling lost her planeswalking abilities.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Plane where Yanling appeared during the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

events.summary: A violent wave devours Yanling's homeland; she is saved and raised by Li Shan.
events.quote: she was saved and raised by a wanderer named Li Shan

events.summary: Li Shan collapses and his body vanishes while Yanling is unconscious.
events.quote: Li Shan's body was nowhere to be found

events.summary: Yanling searches the world for Li Shan, seeking time magic.
events.quote: Yanling searched every corner of the world

events.summary: Yanling and Yanggu are lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun.
Yanling helps protect and rescue civilians, evacuating them to the tunnels with Vraska and the Golgari.
events.quote: they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels

events.summary: Yanling stays to help the Gatewatch fight Bolas and survives; she leaves after his defeat.
events.quote: She and Yanggu survived the battle

events.summary: Yanling loses her planeswalking in the Desparkening and travels via omenpaths to Avishkar to race in the Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find Li Shan.
events.quote: Yanling lost her planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening

relations.quote: After teaming up with Jiang Yanggu
she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde
